test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In how many years will the simple interest on a sum of money be equal to the principal at the rate of 2(6)/(7) % per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Sum of money

Rate (R) = 2(6)/(7) % per annum

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal (P)

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Given that SI = P, we have:

(P × R × T) / 100 = P

⇒ (P × (20 / 7) × T) / 100 = P

⇒ (20PT) / 700 = P

⇒ 20PT = 700P

⇒ 20T = 700

⇒ T = 700 / 20

⇒ T = 35 years

**The correct answer is option 3.**
